source_revision_notes: The 2006 preprint is a Green-Tao paper, not a Green-Tao-Ziegler paper.
The 2006/2010 main theorem is conditional for general finite complexity, while Corollary 1.7 is unconditional only through complexity two.

The later three-author inverse theorem supplies one of the inputs for the arbitrary finite-complexity prime application rather than restating the full prime-counting theorem as its formal main result.
The currently observed inverse-theorem PDF is v5 dated 2026-04-23 and requires a revision and erratum audit before any immutable source mapping.
